verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's homepage claims it lets users 'screen customers' during onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations, which is a first-party but vague screening claim. Nothing in the evidence names sanctions or watchlists, list selection, or screening of companies versus individuals. The Alerts API only ingests alerts from external monitoring systems, so it is adjacent and earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit sanctions/watchlist screening documentation, ability to select specific lists, coverage of both individuals and companies, match/disposition workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen individuals and companies against selected sanctions and watchlists

citations.quote: Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently. Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
